title: The Stopped Cuckoo Clock
scene: At 3:20 PM, the brass cuckoo clock stopped in the workshop. Only the owner noticed the tiny red wax seal wedged in its gears.

suspects.name: Willa Dunn
suspects.testimony: I polished pendulums at the bench right beside the workshop door from 3:05 to 3:25 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: A customer watched Willa polishing pendulums at the bench from 3:05 to 3:25 PM.

suspects.name: Otis Greer
suspects.testimony: I brewed tea in the kitchen from 3:00 to 3:20 PM, then came back and found the stopped clock.
suspects.alibiProof: The mail carrier chatted with Otis at the kitchen back door from 3:05 to 3:20 PM.

suspects.name: Faye Novak
suspects.testimony: I browsed the front window from 3:05 to 3:25 PM—I don't even carry red wax seals!
suspects.contradiction: Nobody had mentioned a red wax seal, and warm red wax flecks were on Faye's thumb.

suspects.name: Percy Walsh
suspects.testimony: I balanced ledgers in the reading nook from 3:00 to 3:25 PM and never entered the workshop.
suspects.alibiProof: The shop webcam shows Percy writing steadily in his ledger from 3:00 to 3:25 PM.
